artifact_observations.reasoning: The white lettering on the green keys appears slightly 'painted on' or digitally superimposed rather than physically molded or stamped. There is a lack of depth interaction between the ink and the key surface curvature.
The rectangular keys to the right of the space bar appear geometrically inconsistent. They seem to merge slightly into the chassis and lack clear separation gaps compared to the left side.
The metal bar and paper roller at the top show slight warping and inconsistent reflection highlights, suggesting minor geometric instability in the background elements.
